# US-08.1 — Run the whole suite offline with one command

|                  |                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Epic**         | [EPIC-08 Quality Assurance & Test Coverage](../epics/EPIC-08-quality-assurance.md)                                            |
| **Priority**     | P1                                                                                                                            |
| **Estimate**     | 3                                                                                                                             |

| **Owning agent** | `qa-engineer`                                                                                                                 |

## User story

**As a** developer,
**I want** one test command that works without credentials or a network,
**so that** I can verify a change without spending cloud budget or depending on live services.

Traceability: **STORY-022 → EPIC-008 → FR-24** in [requirements](../../../agile/requirements.md); NFR-6 and NFR-8 also apply.

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — One root command**
Given installed project and test dependencies,
when I run `pytest` from the repository root,
then it collects the suite only under `tests/`, resolves backend imports through the existing pytest configuration and exits 0 without per-test path edits.

**AC2 — Credentials and network absent**
Given credentials are unset and network access is denied,
when the suite runs,
then every test passes with mocked cloud clients and any attempted real cloud-client construction or network connection fails the test.

**AC3 — Shared fixtures**
Given tests need image bytes, cloud responses or a valid report,
when they use the shared fixture set,
then in-memory PNG bytes and fake GenAI, Firestore, publisher, BigQuery and valid-report fixtures are available without committed image binaries.

**AC4 — Legacy live scripts retired**
Given the repository's test entry points,
when collection and supported test commands are inspected,
then neither `backend/test_analyzer.py` nor `backend/test_pipeline.py` remains a runnable ad-hoc live-cloud test and all supported automated tests run through the offline suite.

## Tasks

- [x] Set `pythonpath = ["backend"]` and `testpaths = ["tests"]` in `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`
- [x] Provide an autouse offline guard that clears credentials, blocks network access and rejects real cloud-client construction
- [x] Generate a shared PNG fixture in memory with Pillow
- [x] Statically enforce no `sys.path` manipulation and one-way layering in `tests/test_package_layout.py`
- [x] Deliver the sprint 1 baseline of 82 passing offline tests
- [ ] Extend shared fixtures with reusable fake GenAI, Firestore, Pub/Sub, BigQuery and valid-report responses where missing
- [ ] Formally retire **both** `backend/test_analyzer.py` and `backend/test_pipeline.py`; preserve any useful assertions in proper mocked tests
- [ ] Verify `pytest` and collection with credentials unset and network denied

## Current state

Sprint 1 is complete, EPIC-001 is closed, and the verified baseline is **82 passing tests**, offline with mocked cloud clients. The import strategy is settled in [pyproject.toml](../../../pyproject.toml): `pythonpath = ["backend"]`, `testpaths = ["tests"]`. No `sys.path` mutation is needed or permitted. [tests/conftest.py](../../../tests/conftest.py) supplies an autouse guard against real clients/network and an in-memory PNG; [tests/test_package_layout.py](../../../tests/test_package_layout.py) enforces layering statically.

The two stale ad-hoc scripts still exist and call live cloud services. `testpaths` prevents their automatic collection, but exclusion is not retirement. Their explicit removal or conversion remains required by this story. Shared success/failure fixtures for the remaining services also need completion; the suite's current green status does not prove untested modules work.

## Test cases

| Test                                                  | Asserts                                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `test_root_pytest_collects_only_offline_suite`        | Root command resolves backend imports and collects only supported tests                       |
| `test_offline_guard_rejects_network_and_real_clients` | Credential-free execution works and deliberate network/client attempts fail                   |
| `test_shared_cloud_and_image_fixtures`                | Required fakes and valid report/PNG fixtures are available without binary files               |
| `test_legacy_live_cloud_scripts_retired`              | Both old scripts are retired and no supported automated entry point calls live cloud services |

## Definition of done

The one-command suite passes offline, all shared fixtures are available, both legacy scripts are retired, package-layout assertions remain green, and no live integration is added to pytest.
